flavor.phonemic_palette: Orc (Kazhur, deep-growl regression): q -> ghr/khr, kh -> KHR, heavy clusters gr/rk/gh/khr, drawn-out guttural growl, suffixes -gur/-rakh/-gor; the Kazhur triliteral root stays faintly under the growl. Brutal, loud, throaty.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Orc — xenophobic tribal of the hills; survival.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Orc are a Chaotic beastman race; aggression 0.8, organized as tribal. Their tongue is a regressed form (see name_bank 'orc'). Stripped record per gdd-culture-catalog §5.3.
